notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.

Three-manual Ecclesia default channels (from the previous D-470 generation): Choir 1, Great 2, Swell 3, Pedal 4, stops 12; CC11 expression 55-127. Not verified for the D-477 itself (DS-Core platform). The D-477 has four swell shoes; only the Swell's CC11 is mapped.
Pedal Lieblich Gedackt 16' and Violone 16' are borrowed from the Choir and Swell.

MIDI scheme: The T-377/D-477/D-577 manual needs a dealer login; MIDI scheme from the Ecclesia T-270/T-370/D-470/D-570 user manual (July 2020), MIDI specifications p. 48: https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/39936-U2nl53k6kxTggXa022IJApZmpyGUyYdo1lp3IDjH1h5QZH7b6KbF2Wt9PTumaFIE-0/Ecclesia%20270-370-470-570%20Usermanual.pdf
